name: MatrixInn Floating Buttons
author: MatrixInn Solutions

sections.description:
MatrixInn Floating Buttons lets you add beautiful floating action buttons to your WordPress site in minutes – no coding required.

Available Buttons

  • WhatsApp – Opens a WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message
  • Call – Direct phone call link for mobile users
  • Email – Opens default email client with pre-filled subject
  • Scroll to Top – Appears after scrolling, smoothly returns to top

Features

  • Enable/disable each button individually
  • Choose left or right position
  • Set bottom distance from screen edge
  • 3 button sizes: Small, Medium, Large
  • Custom color picker for each button
  • Tooltip text for each button
  • Show delay (0-10 seconds)
  • Device control: show on Desktop only, Mobile only, or Both
  • Scroll to Top threshold – set when the button appears
  • Clean uninstall – removes all options on deletion

Lightweight & Fast

  • No external dependencies
  • No jQuery (vanilla JavaScript)
  • CSS animations via transitions only
  • Minimal DOM footprint

Support & documentation

Full setup guide, screenshots and FAQs: MatrixInn Floating Buttons documentation

Built by MatrixInn Solutions, the team behind the MatrixInn GDPR plugin and the WA Float WhatsApp button for Shopify.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the matrixinn-floating-buttons folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins > Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Go to Floating Buttons in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Configure your buttons and save.
sections.faq:
How do I add a WhatsApp button?

Go to Floating Buttons > WhatsApp, enable the button, enter your phone number in international format without the + sign (e.g. 447700900000), and save.

Can I show buttons only on mobile?

Yes. Go to Floating Buttons > General and set “Show On” to “Mobile Only”.

Does this plugin slow down my site?

No. The plugin loads a small CSS file and a tiny vanilla JavaScript file. No external libraries or fonts are loaded.

Where are settings stored?

All settings are stored in WordPress wp_options. No custom database tables are created.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

All plugin settings are completely removed from the database.
